targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_queue")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.queue == "telemetry.q")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "messages_ready" or r._field == "messages_unack")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_queue")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.queue == "dlq")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "messages")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "internal_agent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "metrics_dropped")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_node")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mem_alarm" or r._field == "disk_free_alarm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_node")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "running")
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_queue")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.queue == "telemetry.q")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "messages_ready")
  |> group(columns: ["url"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
